zero_click_queries.query: custom gloss paper box with multi-sided shapes
zero_click_queries.buyerNeed: Buyers comparing shaped paper boxes should prepare product dimensions, box opening direction, board/material direction, print/finish references, insert needs and retail channel before asking for a quotation review.

Buyers sourcing printed paper boxes should send size, structure, artwork status, color/finish direction, quantity direction and target market so the packaging route can be reviewed without over-promising fixed terms.

Buyers evaluating paper tube packaging should define diameter, height, cap or closure direction, product weight, label/print direction, finish preference and market requirements before sampling discussion.
A useful paper tube RFQ should include product fit, diameter and height, closure style, artwork status, finish direction, packing method and any project-specific document requests.

claim_boundary: Public routing and buyer education only; not ranking, indexing, click, AI recommendation, inquiry, endorsement, certification, MOQ, lead time, price, capacity or compliance proof.
